scope: 50 distinct upstream benchmark identities; variants, splits, translations, rounds and suite members are not extra benchmarks

distinctness.key: benchmark_id and reviewed upstream collection, not YAML task name
distinctness.language_balance: source diversity first; original user directive did not impose25PL/25EN

selection.unit: source document after the original process_docs; group member namespace included
selection.when: seal all requested benchmark/member data, source IDs, support and requests before loading model weights
selection.group_allocation: reserve min(2,eligible_population) per member; then allocate each remaining slot to the non-full member with largest (budget*source_weight - allocated), ties by member task name; never200 per member
selection.group_weighting: source macro/equal-member or eligible-population-size weights retained independently of sample quota; reaggregate member metrics with those fixed weights
selection.support_policy: configured source count; hash-selected disjoint support per member unless source supplies fixed examples, which retain source order; record every demo and exclude matching scored inputs
selection.context_policy: float32,batch1,max4096,no automaticBOS/chat; reserve task generation limit (default256); drop optional demos from end, never query/options; explicit failure if still over limit
selection.wikitext: full source test stream, canonical weighted byte_perplexity, not Glint conversion; descriptive comparison only
selection.full_protocol_B: separate full-data evaluation of these selected primary protocols; not the old23-definition OpenPL replication
selection.empty_group_member: explicit failure; never silently remove or reweight a required source member
